Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

draft noun and verb

conscription into the army

also conscription, dodge the draft, draft-dodger, be drafted, call-up

classical

Caes. BG 6.1 (Lewis & Short s.v. dēlēctus)
Traupman 306

dīlēctus, dīlēctūs m.

noun, fourth declension

military draft, levy

Other words

  • dīlēctum habēre — hold a draft

    also used · classical · Caes. BC 1.6 (Lewis & Short s.v. dēlēctus: a standing phrase for recruiting); Traupman 306

  • cōnscrībō, cōnscrībere, cōnscrīpsī, cōnscrīptum — draft, enrol (soldiers)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 306

  • mīlitiam subterfugere — dodge the draft

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 3.97: mīlitiam (Lewis & Short s.v. subterfugiō); Traupman 305

Examples

  • quī mīlitiam subterfugit

    a draft-dodgerTraupman 306

See also recruit.
